games.name: [FEBRUARY] Dead By Roblox
games.desc:
Dead By Roblox is an asymmetrical game where adaptation, teamwork, and determination decides who escapes and who falls.

A team of Survivors must repair five generators, outsmart the Killer, and escape the trial using perks, strategy, and coordination.
The Killer hunts them down, controls the trial, and ensures no one leaves alive.

Whether you choose the Survivor or Killer side, progress by participating in trials and use what you've earned by unlocking new perks, items, add-ons, offerings, and characters to improve your odds of succeeding the next trial you endure.

[September Update]
🛠 Loading times are much shorter now
👣 Killers now has footstep sounds
⚖️Balance changes & smaller changes
💥Updated collisions for both sides
🎂 Removal of anniversary items & decorations
🚫 Lot of bug fixes

EPILEPSY WARNING is hereby given!
May cause Motion Sickness while playing.
